title: Anand
funFact: Amitabh Bachchan won his first Filmfare award, for Best Supporting Actor, for playing the quiet doctor in this film.

title: Zanjeer
funFact: Its brooding cop hero turned Amitabh Bachchan into the 'angry young man' of 1970s Hindi cinema.

title: Bobby
song: Hum Tum Ek Kamre Mein Band Ho
funFact: It was Dimple Kapadia's very first film and Rishi Kapoor's first role as a leading man.

title: Deewaar
funFact: Written by the duo Salim–Javed, its story of two brothers on opposite sides of the law was later remade in several Indian languages.

title: Sholay
funFact: It played non-stop at Mumbai's Minerva theatre for about five years, a record for its time.

title: Chupke Chupke
funFact: Dharmendra plays a botany professor who pretends to be a chauffeur who only speaks very formal, pure Hindi.

title: Kabhi Kabhie
funFact: Amitabh Bachchan plays a poet, and the film's songs were written by the celebrated poet Sahir Ludhianvi.

title: Amar Akbar Anthony
funFact: Three brothers separated as children grow up in Hindu, Muslim and Christian homes, making it a classic 'lost and found' masala film.

title: Don
funFact: Farhan Akhtar remade it in 2006 with Shah Rukh Khan, which grew into a franchise of its own.

title: Golmaal
funFact: Amol Palekar won the Filmfare Best Actor award for this gentle comedy about a fake twin and a moustache-obsessed boss.

title: Qurbani
funFact: Its disco hit was sung by Nazia Hassan, a teenager from Pakistan who became a pop sensation in India overnight.

title: Silsila
funFact: Amitabh Bachchan sang the film's famous Holi song himself, and it still plays at Holi parties every year.

title: Masoom
funFact: This was Shekhar Kapur's first film as director, adapted from Erich Segal's novel 'Man, Woman and Child'.

title: Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro
funFact: Made on a tiny budget with support from the government-run NFDC, this satire on corruption became a cult classic.

title: Mr. India
funFact: The villain Mogambo, played by Amrish Puri, became one of the most imitated characters in Hindi cinema.

title: Ijaazat
funFact: Asha Bhosle and Gulzar both won National Awards for one of its songs, as singer and lyricist.

title: Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak
funFact: It was Aamir Khan's first role as a leading man and his cousin Mansoor Khan's debut as a director.

title: Tezaab
funFact: One of its dance numbers became such a craze that it turned Madhuri Dixit into a household name.

title: Maine Pyar Kiya
funFact: It was Sooraj Barjatya's first film as director and gave Salman Khan his first lead role.

title: Chandni
funFact: Sridevi's chiffon saris in the film started a fashion trend across India.

title: Andaz Apna Apna
funFact: It did poorly in cinemas at first but became a cult comedy thanks to TV reruns and home video.

title: Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!
funFact: It packs in fourteen songs and became one of the biggest box-office hits of the 1990s.

title: Baazigar
funFact: Shah Rukh Khan took a big risk by playing a villainous hero, and it won him his first Filmfare Best Actor award.

title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
funFact: It has been running at Mumbai's Maratha Mandir cinema for decades, the longest run of any film in Indian history.

title: Rangeela
funFact: It was A.R. Rahman's first soundtrack composed directly for a Hindi film.

title: Satya
funFact: Manoj Bajpayee won a National Award for playing the gangster Bhiku Mhatre.

title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai
funFact: It was Karan Johar's debut as a director, and it swept all four major acting awards at that year's Filmfares.

title: Dil Se..
funFact: Its most famous song was filmed with the dancers performing on the roof of a moving train.

title: Sarfarosh
funFact: Director John Matthew Matthan spent years researching the story of cross-border arms smuggling before making this, his first film.

title: Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam
funFact: Budapest in Hungary stood in for Italy in many of the film's foreign scenes.

title: Lagaan
altTitles: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
funFact: It was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.

title: Dil Chahta Hai
funFact: Farhan Akhtar's debut as a director changed how Hindi films showed young city friendships.

title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham...
funFact: Its giant cast put Amitabh and Jaya Bachchan, Shah Rukh Khan, Kajol, Hrithik Roshan and Kareena Kapoor into a single family drama.

title: Devdas
funFact: Based on Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay's classic novel, it was screened at the Cannes Film Festival.

title: Munna Bhai M.B.B.S.
funFact: It was Rajkumar Hirani's first film as director and was later remade in Tamil and Telugu.

title: Koi... Mil Gaya
funFact: Rakesh Roshan directed his son Hrithik, and the film launched the Krrish superhero series.

title: Rang De Basanti
funFact: Besides being India's official Oscar entry, it was nominated for a BAFTA award.

title: Chak De! India
funFact: Many of the women in the team were cast for their real hockey skills rather than their acting experience.

title: Taare Zameen Par
funFact: It was Aamir Khan's first film as director and helped start conversations in India about dyslexia.

title: Jab We Met
funFact: Kareena Kapoor won the Filmfare Best Actress award for playing the chatty, carefree Geet.

title: 3 Idiots
funFact: It was loosely inspired by Chetan Bhagat's novel 'Five Point Someone'.

title: Dabangg
funFact: It was Sonakshi Sinha's debut, and its swaggering cop Chulbul Pandey went on to lead a whole franchise.

title: Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara
funFact: The three friends' road trip across Spain includes the famous La Tomatina tomato-throwing festival.

title: Gangs of Wasseypur
funFact: The story was so long that it was released in two parts, and both were shown at Cannes.

title: Kahaani
funFact: Many street scenes were filmed among real Durga Puja crowds in Kolkata.

title: Queen
funFact: Kangana Ranaut won the National Award for Best Actress for playing a jilted bride who goes on her honeymoon alone.

title: PK
song: Love Is a Waste of Time
funFact: Aamir Khan plays a visitor from another planet who asks innocent but awkward questions about religion.

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan
funFact: Its story came from K. V. Vijayendra Prasad, the writer behind the Baahubali films.

title: Piku
funFact: Amitabh Bachchan won the National Award for Best Actor for playing a cranky father obsessed with his digestion.

title: Dangal
funFact: Based on wrestler Mahavir Singh Phogat and his daughters, it also became a massive hit in China.

title: Andhadhun
funFact: It was inspired by the French short film 'L'Accordeur' (The Piano Tuner), and Ayushmann Khurrana won a National Award for it.

title: Gully Boy
funFact: It was inspired by Mumbai street rappers such as Divine and Naezy, and it became India's Oscar entry.

title: Shershaah
funFact: It tells the story of Captain Vikram Batra, who received the Param Vir Chakra for his bravery in the Kargil War.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
funFact: Alia Bhatt won the National Award for Best Actress for the title role.

title: Pathaan
funFact: It marked Shah Rukh Khan's return as a leading man after more than four years and is part of the YRF Spy Universe.

title: Jawan
funFact: It was the first Hindi film for both director Atlee and actress Nayanthara.

title: 12th Fail
funFact: It is based on the real life of IPS officer Manoj Kumar Sharma, who cleared the civil services exam after many setbacks.

title: Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani
altTitles: Rocky Aur Rani Ki Prem Kahani
funFact: It was Karan Johar's return to directing a feature film after a gap of seven years.

title: Stree 2
funFact: Part of a shared horror-comedy universe, it became one of the highest-grossing Hindi films ever.

title: Laapataa Ladies
funFact: Directed by Kiran Rao and produced by Aamir Khan, it was chosen as India's official Oscar entry.
